group_major_two_context_schedule.group_boundary: prefetch current beta group once, start empty, complete final stage2 before switching group
group_major_two_context_schedule.record_boundary: no flush between records of the same module/group; record cycle rows use attributed timeline deltas

per_task_cycles.fixed_bank_lower_bound: maximum kept population over eight modulo banks
per_task_cycles.stage2: registered issue-before-accept reservoir: issue at most one queued ID per modulo-eight bank, then accept at most one packed bucket word if post-issue occupancy plus its kept suffix is <=16; drain-only words still cost one cycle; tail drains to empty

mechanism.b0: strict direct K8 bypass: no metadata prefetch, lookup, capture, bucket, reservoir or drop
mechanism.encoding: smallest code c with exact beta<=U[c]
mechanism.ordering: stable ascending (four-bit code, source_id) over the current token active subset
mechanism.raw_error_bound: abs(sum dropped signed INT8 weights per destination)<=sum exact beta<=sum conservative U<=B
mechanism.runtime_rule: drop the maximal stable active prefix whose cumulative conservative U is <=B; keep the first source that would exceed B and all later sources

combined_total_includes: two-context startup, drain, context waits and stage starvation
